# CLA signatures

Each line records agreement to the [DETAIL Contributor License Agreement](../CLA.md). Add yours in
your first pull request, in a commit you make yourself. The CLA check reads the first column, so
keep the username exactly as GitHub shows it. Add only your own line, and leave the others as
they are: the check refuses anything else (`scripts/check_cla.py`).
